key_factors: Home advantage at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles — massive crowd support as co-hosts
Pulisic, Reyna, Weah and Balogun form a dangerous attacking unit
Paraguay missing Julio Enciso (hamstring/quad injury, 2-3 weeks) — biggest attacking threat gone
Paraguay give up 6 set-piece situations per game in qualifying — McKennie and USA exploit this
USA lead all-time head-to-head 5-2 and beat Paraguay in a recent 2026 friendly
reasoning: USA enter this as strong favourites and Paraguay's Enciso injury is tournament-defining. Without their most creative attacker, Paraguay's already low-scoring approach loses its danger. The USMNT's set-piece threat via McKennie and the width of Weah and Freeman should unlock Paraguay's block. Pre-tournament losses to Portugal, Belgium and Germany were friendly results — the squad is cohesive and Pochettino has had months to prepare. Pulisic is motivated on home soil. USA win 2-1, Paraguay grabbing a consolation through Almirón or Sanabria on the counter late. Confidence medium because Paraguay's defensive discipline is real.
